text: Their Pluto sits on your Venus, and the first thing to go is your ability to like them mildly. Venus is the part of you that finds things pleasant: whose company you enjoy, what you call beautiful, how you show a person that they matter to you. A conjunction fuses that with their capacity to intensify whatever it touches. Nothing about them stays a matter of taste. Your regard for them runs strong or it runs absent, and you may notice that the middle setting you use with almost everyone else has stopped working here. What their presence does to your values is the more interesting half. The things you like, you tend to like harder around them, and the ones you had been liking out of habit stop holding. Taste often shifts inside a connection like this: in music, in rooms, in what an evening is for, in what counts as good enough. Some of that is a pleasure in itself. Some of it is the loss of an ease you had been counting on. Venus keeps a lot of low-grade agreeableness in circulation, small settlements about what you accept as affection or as fair treatment, and their Pluto will not let those stay quiet. You get a clear look at the terms you have been living on, and the look is not always flattering. Your half of the exchange is easy to underrate. Their Pluto marks material that people around them handle carefully, if they acknowledge it at all. It gets feared, managed, worked around. Your Venus does the one thing almost nobody does with it: finds it attractive. You make their depth desirable rather than merely serious, and being wanted at exactly the place where a person expects to be avoided is not a small event in a life. It can unsettle them more than their intensity ever unsettles you. The charge in this contact deserves plain statement. Attention here runs hot, and each of you is likely to be more taken up with the other than ordinary acquaintance would explain. That is what the geometry does. It says nothing about how either of you behaves with it. Two people with this contact can build a bond in which affection gets rebuilt from the foundations, or a long argument about who holds the upper hand, and the aspect does not choose between them. Conduct is not in a chart. What tends to change in you is the price you put on things. Casual approval stops working as currency, first from them and later from other people as well. You find out that you would rather be seen accurately than be liked comfortably, which is a genuine trade with a genuine cost. Whatever the two of you turn out to be to each other, your sense of what is worth wanting will not go back to what it was.

A sextile is a door rather than a pull, and this one opens onto the serious end of what you enjoy. Your Venus and their Pluto can reach each other whenever either of you decides to use the connection. On the days neither of you bothers, the acquaintance stays light and nothing is lost. On the days you do, the register changes quickly. What you get from them, when you take the offer, is an accurate read on worth. You bring them something you like: a plan, a person, an expense you are talking yourself into, a compromise you have half accepted. They tend to see what it actually costs you, and they say so in a sentence, without heat. Most people either flatter your taste or argue with it, and they do neither. That makes them useful in the places where liking a thing and the thing being good are not the same question. You may find your judgment about value gets sharper in their company, and that none of the sharpening came from being talked into anything. Your side of the trade is that you make their depth welcome without turning it into a project. Intensity usually meets either alarm or fascination, and both are wearing to be on the receiving end of. Venus offers a third response, which is enjoyment. You can find the heavy part of someone good company. For a person accustomed to being treated as a lot to handle, being treated as attractive instead is a real relief, and here it costs you nothing to give. In shared work the pairing does well wherever taste and leverage meet: a negotiation, a hire, a design decision, the division of something whose parts are not equal. You know what is worth having. They know what it will take and who is actually holding what. Among friends or relatives it usually shows up as the one person whose opinion you want before you commit to something. None of that happens unless somebody starts it. You can carry this contact for years as a vague sense that they are more interesting than most, never once take the conversation past the surface, and nothing will go wrong to force it. What goes unused stays theoretical. The intensity also shows up at low volume, which is easier to miss. Around them, pleasure gets more definite. Something you would have called nice becomes something you want, and something you had put up with becomes something you decline. The aspect is doing its work quietly, which is the only way a sextile ever works. Growth here comes in small increments. Each time you let them look at something you value and tell you the truth about it, the trade gets easier to make. Across a long acquaintance that produces an uncommon kind of taste, one that has been checked by someone who never confused the pleasant with the worthwhile.

Your instinct in most rooms is to keep things agreeable. What is unsettled gets smoothed, what is harsh gets softened, and the return on that is that you are easy to be around. Their Pluto stands at right angles to the whole method. It reads a smoothed surface as a place where something is being kept, and it does not let the matter drop. You are likely to feel this as having your affection audited. Ordinary warmth from you, the kind that costs you little and that most people accept gratefully, does not land with them as simple. They want to know what it is for. You may find yourself asked, out loud or by implication, whether you actually like them or are only being nice, and the question is hard to answer because in Venus the two are genuinely tangled. Around them, charm stops working as a way through a difficult hour. That is uncomfortable, and it is what the angle is for. Your half is not passive, and it is the half the tradition usually leaves out. What your Venus asks of their Pluto is lightness, and lightness is what their depth supplies least easily. You want to be enjoyed. An afternoon that is about nothing in particular is a real request and not a small one, and so is being liked out loud with no investigation attached. That request presses on something in them that learned to treat pleasure as either unserious or unsafe, and it is one of the few demands that makes intensity of this kind bend instead of dig in. You are harder on them than you know. This pair has a reputation, so the honest note belongs here. The square guarantees force between what you value and what they intensify. It guarantees nothing about conduct. Two people with this angle can spend years taking each other's measure and both come out with a clearer sense of their own worth, or they can settle into a standoff where one presses and the other placates, and the geometry does not decide which. A chart shows pressure. What a person does under pressure belongs to that person. Where the pressure pays off is in what you are willing to call valuable. Squares produce motion, and here the motion runs through your sense of what things are worth. Preferences you kept because they were inherited, or because disagreeing was tiring, do not survive much exposure to them. Compliments stop working on you unless they are accurate. Regard, once you have given it, becomes very difficult to argue you out of, and you hand it over less often than you used to. That is a real change, and while it is happening it does not feel like growth. It feels like being found out again by someone who will not take the pleasant version. The workable position is neither hardening nor going along. You can let them look, disagree out loud where you disagree, and go on liking what you like without needing their signature on the list. Do that often enough and what you value becomes something you can state plainly, in your own words, under somebody's full attention.

What you value, they take seriously. That reads as mild on the page and it is not mild in practice, because most regard is casual and theirs is not. Your Venus reaches their Pluto along an easy angle, so their whole capacity for depth ends up pointed at your pleasures, your taste, and the people and things you have decided are worth your care. It arrives as backing rather than as scrutiny. In daily terms, you get taken at full weight in the areas where you are usually taken lightly. A preference you mentioned once is remembered. Something you are quietly proud of gets treated as significant rather than charming. When you say you want something, they hear the wanting and not the politeness wrapped around it. This is often the person who acts on what you said you liked, at more expense or effort than the remark appeared to warrant. Your side is that you give their intensity a pleasant place to be. Depth with no comfortable outlet turns grim and feeds on itself. Aimed at someone whose company it enjoys, it becomes generous: they put resources behind what you care about, they defend your interests in rooms you are not in, they take your side in a way that goes well past agreement. Trines work without announcing themselves, so you may be some distance into this before you register how much of it there is. Two things go wrong with an angle this comfortable. The first is that nothing here demands use. You can hold it in reserve and spend a decade on light conversation, leaving the depth a capacity rather than an experience, and no part of the geometry will mind. The second is quieter and comes from this particular pairing. When intensity of this order is comfortable to receive, it can reset what you expect affection to feel like. Care that arrives without the charge starts to read as thin. That is no verdict on anyone else in your life, but it is a real effect, and it works on you rather than on them. The same softness lets the connection go unexamined. Nothing in a trine will interrupt to ask what the two of you actually are to each other, and a question nobody asks tends to get answered by default. Worked rather than coasted on, this stops being a comfort and starts being a resource. The serious version of you is the version on offer here, and the pleasant version is not a performance put on for the occasion. A bad stretch does not send the two of you back to establishing basic terms, because the ground under the connection was never conditional on things going well. You can return to it without discussion, in a difficult year as readily as an easy one.

You would like to be liked, and they want to know what the liking is made of. Those two positions sit directly opposite each other here, which means they do not blend and they do not go quiet. Under most exchanges between you there is a small negotiation running about what things are worth: your company, their attention, the favor one of you did the other last month. What you meet in them is someone standing exactly where your charm does not reach. Venus works by making things pleasant, and pleasant is usually enough. It is not enough in this direction. They see the calculation inside a kindness before you have admitted to yourself that there was one, and they see the part of your generosity that is a way of staying safe. Being read like that is not comfortable. It is also more accurate than the treatment you get almost anywhere else, which is why a bond like this is difficult to leave behind and difficult to relax inside. You do the same to them from the other end. Your ordinary wish for affection, given and returned without ceremony, lands on the part of them that does not believe anything comes free. A person can be very hard to move and still be caught off guard by being straightforwardly liked. You are also the one who can name what their intensity costs, out loud, because you are the one paying it, and few people ever stand close enough to say so. The pull deserves plain description. Oppositions hold on, and a Venus that has been met by a Pluto does not detach on schedule. You may find yourself more occupied with this person than you can account for, and unable to keep them at the neutral distance you manage with everyone else. The geometry produces that much weight and stops there. It is not a report on anyone's behavior, and no chart can tell you how a person conducts themselves. Popular astrology writes this pair up as possession and ruin. What it actually records is weight. Watch for the usual split, where one of you gets handed the entire intensity. It is convenient to decide that they are the one who cares too much while you are merely fond, or that they hold the depth and you hold the good manners. Both halves belong to both of you. The angle only puts them at opposite ends of the same line. Oppositions complete as well as confront, and this one has something to give. Left alone, your Venus can spend years keeping a surface nice. Left alone, their Pluto can go a long time without anything it enjoys. Facing each other, the two correct: your regard acquires a spine, their depth acquires somewhere pleasant to arrive. Whatever becomes of the bond itself, what you are likely to carry out of it is a sturdier estimate of your own worth, reached in front of someone who was never going to accept the easy version.
